description: ShadowCostCritic (Q-017 additive w_epist·sigma) implemented+tested; proven closed-loop redundant with obstacle cost for single convex obstacle (needs blind-corner scenario)
Q-017 redundancy claim is a seed-0 artifact (2/24 seeds); removed false test, added seed-ensemble replacement; #67 CI red->green
Promote seed/speed/completion controls to eval.mppi_sandbox.ab; shadow-cost test refactored onto it, 62->76 tests
Baseline MPPI update weights raw noise not realized perturbation; ~100% weight mass on clipped samples; fix withheld (re-baselines #67/68/69)
Q-017 direction dies at n=24 (15/5 p=0.041) and is bit-inert on 3/4 rescopes; inertness is homotopy knife-edge, not missing signal
Shipped lam=0.1 gives ESS~1/256 (greedy argmin); Q-017 inertness is temperature not homotopy; audible at lam=1.2 but still non-directional (10/5/9 p=0.30)
ESS is first-class in ab (median_ess/ess_in_band/assert_ess_in_band); per-seed spans 5x at fixed lam so arm-median verdict admits 2 of 3 non-compliant temps
